body: Forward test of the promise-tracker credibility method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Evidence: 8-K 20-Oct-2026 (Q3 2026): orders +49%, revenue +18%, EPS +36%; guidance raised 'across the board': adjusted revenue growth ~19–20% (prior high-teens), operating profit $10.9–11.0B (prior $10.55–10.75B), adjusted EPS $8.00–8.10 (prior $7.65–7.85), FCF $9.1–9.4B. 2025 adjusted EPS was $6.37 (vs a final 2025 guide that, from memory, topped out near $6.20 — unverified). Reasoning: Culp-era GE has habitually guided conservatively and finished above range; the narrow 10-cent band after a big raise still leaves room for a Q4 beat given 49% order growth. Resolution: YES if GE Aerospace's reported FY2026 adjusted EPS (Q4 2026 earnings release, non-GAAP as defined by the company) ≥ $8.10. Source: GE Aerospace Q4 2026 earnings 8-K (SEC EDGAR, CIK 40545). Resolve by 2027-02-15; score with Brier vs base rate.
